recognize_zh: 抹片邊緣附近可見約十顆型態正常的分葉嗜中性球緊密擠成一團（neutrophil clumping），而其他區域白血球很少，提示體外聚集造成的假性嗜中性球減少（pseudoneutropenia）。
features: Tight aggregate of about ten mature segmented neutrophils near the feathered edge
Individual neutrophils have normal segmented nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm
No leukocytes dispersed elsewhere in the field
Background red cells with target-like central pallor and scattered platelets
No phagocytosed material or bacteria in the aggregate
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a tight cluster of morphologically normal segmented neutrophils located near the feathered edge, while the rest of the field contains no dispersed leukocytes. Red cells form a monolayer and platelets are present individually without clumping. No toxic changes or organisms are seen in the aggregated neutrophils. Findings are consistent with in vitro neutrophil aggregation, a cause of spuriously low automated white cell and neutrophil counts; a repeat count using citrate or heparin anticoagulant or a fingerstick smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Genuine neutropenia shows sparse neutrophils evenly across the slide without clusters at the feathered edge, and persists with alternate anticoagulants.
Satellitism shows platelets encircling individual neutrophils, rather than neutrophils adhering to one another.

ddx.dx: Leukoagglutination due to storage or infection
ddx.vs: Clumps with engulfed bacteria or fibrin strands suggest bacteremia or delayed processing, whereas these aggregates contain clean normal neutrophils.
